name: feature-spec
description: Turns a raw product idea into a functional specification in two passes: spec-writer runs the mandatory challenge, then interview, then write sequence; spec-second-pass reads the result with another model and amends it with what the first pass left out. Ships the workflow-feature-spec skill with the specification template, which a project may replace with its own. Conception only: it never invents a missing fact, never settles an open reflection, never publishes anywhere.
